flight.plan: Every third paperback free; must not stack with bulk discount.

intent.title: Buy 2 get 1 free on paperbacks
intent.body: In subtotal(), for paperback lines every third copy is free (qty 3 → pay for 2, qty 6 → pay for 4). It does not stack with the bulk discount: apply whichever gives the lower line price. Add tests.

contrail.text: Every third paperback free; must not stack with bulk discount.
Kept integer cents everywhere; rounding happens once per line.
